title: Investigation of luminescence properties and ratiometric thermometry through yellow-to-blue Dy3+ emission in Ca3La7(SiO4)5(PO4)O2 apatite
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19623-19639
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01912E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abir Douzi, Sami Slimi, Eduard Madirov, Josep Maria Serres, Rosa Maria Solé, Ezzedine Ben Salem, Andrey Turshatov, Bryce S. Richards, Xavier Mateos
Dy3+-doped CLSPO apatite phosphors show strong luminescence, thermal stability, and reliable temperature sensing via yellow-to-blue emission ratios, making them ideal for optical thermometry and solid-state lighting applications.
